title: In Silico Design of Dual Estrogen Receptor and Hsp90 Inhibitors for ER-Positive Breast Cancer Through a Mixed Ligand/Structure-Based Approach.
authors: La Monica, Gabriele; Alamia, Federica; Bono, Alessia; Mingoia, Francesco; Martorana, Annamaria; Lauria, Antonino
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟设计ER与Hsp90双靶点抑制剂，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Breast cancer remains one of the most prevalent and lethal malignancies in women, particularly the estrogen receptor-positive (ER+) subtype, which accounts for approximately 70% of cases. Traditional endocrine therapies, including aromatase inhibitors, selective estrogen receptor degraders/antagonists (SERDs), and selective estrogen receptor modulators (SERMs), have improved outcomes for metastatic ER+ breast cancer. However, resistance to these agents presents a significant challenge. This study explores a novel therapeutic strategy involving the simultaneous inhibition of the estrogen receptor (ER) and the chaperone protein Hsp90, which is crucial for the stabilization of various oncoproteins, including ER itself. We employed a hybrid, hierarchical in silico virtual screening approach to identify new dual ER/Hsp90 inhibitors, utilizing the Biotarget Predictor Tool (BPT) for efficient multitarget screening of a large compound library. Subsequent structure-based studies, including molecular docking analyses, were conducted to further evaluate the interaction of the top candidates with both ER and Hsp90. Supporting this, molecular dynamics simulations demonstrate the high stability of the multitarget inhibitor 755435 in complex with ER and Hsp90. Our findings suggest that several small molecules, particularly compound 755435, exhibit promising potential as dual inhibitors, representing a new avenue to overcome resistance in ER+ breast cancer.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌仍是女性中最常见且致死率最高的恶性肿瘤之一，尤其是雌激素受体阳性（ER+）亚型，约占病例的70%。传统内分泌疗法，包括芳香化酶抑制剂、选择性雌激素受体降解剂/拮抗剂（SERDs）和选择性雌激素受体调节剂（SERMs），已改善了转移性ER+乳腺癌的预后。然而，对这些药物的耐药性构成了重大挑战。本研究探索了一种新型治疗策略，涉及同时抑制雌激素受体（ER）和伴侣蛋白Hsp90，后者对包括ER本身在内的多种癌蛋白的稳定至关重要。我们采用了一种混合、分层的计算机虚拟筛选方法，以识别新的双靶点ER/Hsp90抑制剂，利用生物靶点预测工具（BPT）对大型化合物库进行高效多靶点筛选。随后进行了基于结构的研究，包括分子对接分析，以进一步评估顶级候选化合物与ER和Hsp90的相互作用。支持这一发现的是，分子动力学模拟表明多靶点抑制剂755435与ER和Hsp90复合物具有高度稳定性。我们的研究结果表明，几种小分子，特别是化合物755435，展现出作为双靶点抑制剂的良好潜力，代表了克服ER+乳腺癌耐药性的新途径。
